bodyRight:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production skeletal animation TORSO cutout for the same robot dog as input1. Input1 is the EXACT identity/material/color reference. Input2 is ONLY a crude silhouette and socket-position blueprint; DO NOT copy its flat drawing style. Render in the detailed soft 3D style of input1.
Show ONE SINGLE FULL UPPER BODY, facing strictly RIGHT, in a near SIDE PROFILE (only15degree three-quarter). This must read as a horizontal QUADRUPED DOG, not a front-facing puppy or biped. Long horizontal rounded white/blue torso with two visible round blue limb sockets, hind socket at32%canvaswidth, front socket at65%canvaswidth, both at73%canvasheight. The head is above the FRONT socket on the RIGHT half, nose points RIGHT and small tail is on the LEFT. Four-legged dog silhouette, rigid body, head width about38%canvaswidth. Face screen visible obliquely with cyan "67" in the correct normal order. Black floppy ear panels, white smooth shell, bright blue original panels. Preserve friendly original identity.
REMOVE ALL FOUR LEGS AND ALL FEET. Keep round shoulder and hip socket caps in torso. Everything below75%canvasheight must be transparent empty. Draw no stumps or paws. New limbs will be animated beneath those sockets in code. Socket centerline must be horizontal. Keep all head ears and tail within canvas8%padding. Match the proportions and socket positions in input2, while restoring original high-quality robot materials from input1. No front view, no grid or multiple poses, no labels, no floor, no shadows, no specks, no matte, no extra text. Genuine transparent RGBA empty backdrop.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent separated body/limb sprites for a small WEB APP PET's skeletal animation, not an animation frame atlas. Input image is the EXACT original character; preserve original colors, identity, proportions, materials and detailed 3D illustration style.
Output uniform FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, eight equal cells, one isolated part in each. Transparent RGBA alpha-zero empty backdrop. No grid lines, labels, text, shadows, floor, glow, matte or colored residue. Every part fully inside cell with clear transparent margins.
READ LEFT TO RIGHT:
1 (top left): complete RIGID UPPER BODY facing RIGHT, side/slight three-quarter view, but ALL LEGS AND FEET REMOVED. Keep head, torso, arms/props and all characteristic features. Body ends at the hips; empty transparent space below. Do not draw a sitting creature.
2 (top second): same LEGLESS upper body facing directly FRONT, same scale and model.
3 (top third): same LEGLESS upper body facing LEFT (other side), identical model and scale.
4 (top right): ONE detached complete RIGHT-facing FOOT, from ankle down, matching the original character. No leg attached above ankle.
5 (bottom left): ONE detached UPPER LEG segment, from hip joint to knee joint. Straight down, vertical axis. No torso, no foot, no complete creature. Round overlapping joint ends for articulation.
6 (bottom second): ONE detached LOWER LEG segment, knee to ankle, straight down vertical axis. No foot. Round overlapping joint ends.
7 (bottom third): ONE detached LEFT-facing complete FOOT, matching cell4 from the opposite side.
8 (bottom right): ONE detached FRONT-facing complete FOOT.
The foot soles are flat/grounded in neutral pose. These parts will be assembled and moved by code with constant bone lengths; do NOT depict any walking pose. Match materials across every part, do not change the shape between views. Render character parts with soft detailed antialiased edges for readability at96px.

FOOT is HUGE and wide, with the same five large rounded wooden toes as original, ankle stump low above heel. Keep feet original warm golden tan, not dark bark. Don't add props or flowers.
